Name: lovely and young Miss Marnie
Author: EdelAnn
Description:
A portrait module may update the whole series of characters later, and there are still many shortcomings. If I get your support, I promise to improve the quality of the portrait. The focus of this portrait is to highlight Marni's dangerous hairstyle and shy and proud expression. If you also like Marni and Jody, please support me more!


这是我做的第一个人物肖像模组，后续可能会出人物整体系列的更新，还有很多缺点。如果我得到您的支持，我保证会提高肖像的质量。

这个肖像重点是突出玛尼的危险发型，和害羞傲娇表情。

如果你也喜欢玛尼、乔迪的话就多多支持我吧！
